meta.title: For Agencies | Cluega
meta.description: The world's top agencies use Cluega to run their clients' cross-platform advertising——many accounts, big budgets, 24/7 automatic optimization, one entry point in full control, with 100% of the final decision kept in your hands.

hero.title: Empower every client account, handed to an AI that watches the board for you
hero.subtitle: The world's top agencies use Cluega to run their clients' cross-platform advertising——many accounts, big budgets, 24/7 automatic optimization, one entry point in full control, with 100% of the final decision kept in your hands.

items.title: Complete cross-account visibility
items.body: Every hour it refreshes the ad status of every client account under your name, across TikTok, Meta and Google——no more switching between a dozen back-office dashboards; the delivery health of all your clients on a single screen.

items.title: Data that turns straight into action
items.body: No vague optimization advice. The system distills every issue into a concrete, data-backed instruction you can click to run, or hand to AI management with one tap——delivery efficiency lifted more than tenfold.

items.title: Shoulder to shoulder with the industry leaders
items.body: 800,000,000+ marketing data signals processed weekly, 5,200,000+ protocol tasks executed automatically each month, sub-50ms response latency, 99.98% always-on——hand the heaviest cross-platform computation to a delivery engine proven at scale.

lifecycle.title: One platform to manage the full delivery lifecycle of every client

tabs.subtitle: Authorize and account intelligence goes live
tabs.body: The moment you connect an ad account, Cluega analyzes its full history in the background——from conversion volume and cost trends to creative performance and audience saturation. No tedious setup at all; deep analysis runs instantly.

tabs.subtitle: Every account matched to the strategy for its stage
tabs.body: A brand-new account and one that has run for two years need completely different strategies. Cluega automatically classifies accounts into the six M0–M5 maturity stages (from cold start to flywheel), filtering out noise at each stage so it only analyzes the core metrics that truly matter.

tabs.subtitle: Know in a second which ad set is worth betting on
tabs.body: By jointly assessing the two dimensions of "data confidence" and "performance momentum," it scores every ad set precisely. From grade S (rising star, one tap to add budget) to grade D (a candidate to pause), so every cent of client budget is spent where it counts.

tabs.subtitle: Set the boundaries, and AI runs autonomously within them
tabs.body: Once account data hits the goals you set, turn on management——add budget, pause ad sets, rotate creative, and AI executes directly. When an ad is rejected it pushes to Lark / Line; just confirm on your phone, no need to watch the back office.

built.title: Built for agencies
built.overview: Cluega lets agencies serve more client accounts with fewer people, and turns delivery results into something predictable and deliverable.

cards.title: Centralized multi-client management
cards.body: All client accounts, plans and review statuses managed centrally through a single unified interface——no more bouncing between back offices.

cards.title: Human–AI command room
cards.body: GPT tunes budgets, Claude generates suggestions, partners bid manually——all recorded on the same timeline, so anyone who takes over knows the whole picture in a second.

cards.title: Client reports from a single sentence
cards.body: Type the metrics you want to see and Cluega automatically pulls data from authorized platforms, builds charts and syncs in real time——weekly client reports delivered in minutes.

quote.text: Before, just switching between everyone's back offices ate up half a day; now one screen shows every status, even review progress is crystal clear, and delivery efficiency has genuinely gone way up
quote.name: Marcus Vance
